_comment: The SSH server, installed and uninstalled like every other module; the mechanics are each platform's own. Linux installs the package and starts its unit, and uninstall removes the package; Windows adds and removes the capability; macOS switches Remote Login, since its sealed system volume lets nothing be removed. Uninstalling is allowed because the agent channel, not SSH, is the management path.
name: openssh_server
title: SSH server
description: Lets the gateway manage this machine directly over SSH
